_comment: SDXL + IPAdapter character-consistency keyframe workflow (ComfyUI API format). The pipeline auto-selects this file (config workflows.keyframe_ref) for any shot that carries a character reference face; shots without a face use keyframe_flux_api.json. Injects a reference face via IPAdapter so the person matches the character bible. Placeholders: {{POS_PROMPT}} {{NEG_PROMPT}} {{SEED}} {{WIDTH}} {{HEIGHT}} {{REF_IMAGE}}(face filename in ComfyUI input/, uploaded by the pipeline). REQUIRED MODELS (exact filenames, all installed/downloading): checkpoints/sd_xl_base_1.0.safetensors ; ipadapter/ip-adapter-plus-face_sdxl_vit-h.safetensors ; clip_vision/CLIP-ViT-H-14-laion2B-s32B-b79K.safetensors. AUTO-RESOLUTION VERIFIED against cubiq/ComfyUI_IPAdapter_plus utils.py: IPAdapterUnifiedLoader preset 'PLUS FACE (portraits)' selects the ipadapter file via regex 'plus.face.sdxl.vit.h' (matches ip-adapter-plus-face_sdxl_vit-h.safetensors) and the CLIP-vision file via the default ViT-H regex 'ViT.H.14.*s32B.b79K' (matches CLIP-ViT-H-14-laion2B-s32B-b79K.safetensors). Put the IPAdapter model under models/ipadapter/ (the loader scans the 'ipadapter' folder; 'sdxl_models' also works if you keep that legacy layout). REQUIRED CUSTOM NODES: ComfyUI_IPAdapter_plus (cubiq) for IPAdapterUnifiedLoader + IPAdapter (both class_types confirmed present in IPAdapterPlus.py NODE_CLASS_MAPPINGS). If auto-resolution ever fails, it is a file-placement/naming issue, not a node issue.
